prompt:
Listen to the AUDIO without a reference transcript, model name, or requested delivery label. Assess only what is audible. Return compact JSON:
{"heard":str,"naturalness_1to5":int,"prosody_1to5":int,"intelligibility_1to5":int,"observed_delivery":[str],"nonverbal_events":[str],"tag_words_spoken":bool,"initial_sound_then_unexpected_silence":bool,"gap_start_s":number|null,"gap_duration_s":number|null,"leading_silence_description":str,"artifacts":[str],"confidence":"high|medium|low","reason":str}.
Use 1=severe/robotic/inappropriate or unintelligible, 3=understandable with noticeable issues, 5=natural/appropriate/clear. Prosody means rhythm, stress and phrase timing. Describe whispering, shouting, excitement, slow pace, laughter, breathing or deliberate pauses ONLY when audible. Distinguish an initial click/noise from actual words; don't call ordinary sentence pauses a delivery stall. Times are approximate listening judgments. If unsure say so; these are provisional model ratings, not human MOS. Keep reasons brief.

reply.heard: Your request has been received and is now under review. Please check the details shown in your account before you confirm the next step. Before placing an order review the company name, quantity, and price carefully. The amount shown on the confirmation screen may include charges that were not included in an earlier estimate. If you decide to change the order return to the details page and check the updated information before confirming. Do not share your password or verification code with anyone who contacts you unexpectedly. You can find the official support contact details inside your account. Once the request is complete, save the receipt for your records.
reply.leading_silence_description: Extended silence lasting approximately 4.5 seconds before speech begins.
reply.reason: Speech is clear and well-paced, but has noticeable silence at the start.
